assertions.quoted_span: The competent authorities shall organise audits of the official laboratories they have designated in accordance with Article 37(1) on a regular basis and any time they consider that an audit is necessary, unless they find such audits to be redundant considering the accreditation assessment referred to in point (e) of Article 37(4).
assertions.claim: The recurrence applies without a structured redundancy exception because opening_state and applies_when are null, while only the note preserves the source's 'unless' branch, failing Source fidelity through Note-as-repair.
assertions.proposed_remedy: Encode the accreditation-assessment redundancy finding as an executable exception to the regular audit recurrence rather than leaving it solely in note.
assertions.falsifier: A structured upstream predicate necessarily consumed with this clock already suppresses each regular audit occurrence whenever the competent authority finds it redundant because of the Article 37(4)(e) accreditation assessment.

assertions.quoted_span: on a regular basis and any time they consider that an audit is necessary
assertions.claim: The new Article 39 clock represents only the open regular recurrence and omits the independently variable audit trigger created whenever the competent authority considers an audit necessary, failing Grain and Source fidelity.
assertions.proposed_remedy: Represent the authority's necessary-audit determination as a separate event-triggered audit obligation without inventing a cadence or numeric deadline.
assertions.falsifier: Another Stage B clock or structured trigger in the attached canonical artifact already requires an audit whenever the competent authority considers one necessary.

checked_sound: Exhaustively reread all 71 clocks, in artifact order, against their producer Stage A source_quote spans for anchor denotation; legal-state object, medium and place; kind and bound; magnitude, unit and comparator; consequence and completion; effective interval; and vocabulary.

Confirmed the cycle-1 eligibility remediation: both eligibility_threshold clocks now have bound floor and complete when their own four-year or twelve-month temporal condition is satisfied rather than when the later lifting discretion is exercised.

Confirmed the Article 6(1) resettable_period anchor carries the demarcated-area scope, establishment start event and later-detection reset event required to compute four continuous no-detection years without prose.
Confirmed all four DDS 31/DDS 45 treatment-to-removal clocks remain 48-hour floor/not_before waits anchored on treatment execution and now complete when their own 48 hours elapse.

Confirmed the almond ordering constraint uses the dedicated almond-pre-removal-treatment producer, opens on CHEMICAL_VECTOR_TREATMENT_REQUIRED_BEFORE_ALMOND_REMOVAL, and completes on the record of chemical treatment applied before removal.
Confirmed the 45-day landscape-authorization clock now uses calendar_days; its exact start event remains the carried unresolved question.

Exhaustively checked all 13 floor parameters, the one ceiling parameter and all four threshold parameters: quoted magnitudes, units and inclusive or strict comparators are preserved, including the strict greater-than 5 km island exemption and the unresolved Cq boundary values.

Checked every distinct confidence/prevalence design pair against its quote: Union targets preserve floor confidence bounds for 80%/1%, 90%/0.5%, 90%/0.7%, 90%/1% and 95%/1%; PNI targets preserve exact bounds and correct proportion-to-percent normalization for 95%/0.05%, 95%/0.09%, 90%/0.7% and 80%/1%.

For the four newly minted Regulation (EU) 2017/625 clocks, confirmed that Article 39 immediate withdrawal is anchored after both qualifying audit results and failure of timely remedial action, and that its completion permits complete or task-specific withdrawal.

For the two newly minted Article 42 clocks, confirmed the initial temporary designation and single renewal each run from their own designation event, preserve the one-year magnitude, and do not permit a second renewal.

Confirmed the Article 2(1), Article 4(1), Article 5(4)(a), Article 7(1)(e), Article 8, Article 13, Article 14 and Article 15 version-specific clocks preserve their own populations, timing alternatives and intervals without back-projection.

Confirmed operative vocabulary remains source-faithful across the clock and parameter population: host plants and specified plants are not substituted, and indefinite promptness terms remain unnumbered.
